statement: SpaceX says its understanding with NVIDIA is that it will receive a very significant percentage of NVIDIA's GPUs in calendar 2027.
why: If one customer absorbs a large share of next year's output, NVIDIA's revenue base narrows and other buyers face tighter allocation.

impact.mechanism: Concentrated allocation to one buyer secures NVIDIA volume but raises customer-concentration risk and reduces GPUs available to everyone else.

evidence.excerpt: Our understanding with NVIDIA is that we will receive a very significant percentage of their GPUs next year.
We expect to have a very large share of Nvidia's GPUs next year.

confidence.basis: Buyer-side claim in a secondary transcript, unquantified and not confirmed by NVIDIA.
